Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete

GO:0045157 electron transporter, transferring electrons within the noncyclic electron transport pathway of photosynthesis activity MF + BP

Because they combine MF terms with CC

see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/19015
